tools.name: exely_list_properties
tools.description: List the properties that this API connection can read, with their ids. Start here to find a propertyId. Pass include='All' for the hotel info, room types, rate plans and services. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties.

tools.name: exely_get_property
tools.description: Get the description of one property: name, address, contacts and content. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties/{propertyId}.

tools.name: exely_get_cancellation_rules
tools.description: Get the cancellation rules that the property set for its bookings. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties/{propertyId}/cancellation-rules.

tools.name: exely_get_extra_stay_rules
tools.description: Get the early check-in and late check-out rules of one property. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties/{propertyId}/extra-stay-rules.

tools.name: exely_list_room_type_categories
tools.description: List the room type categories that Exely uses (for example single, double, suite). Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/room-type-categories.

tools.name: exely_list_meal_plans
tools.description: List the meal plan options that Exely uses (for example breakfast included). Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/meal-plans.

tools.name: exely_list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms and suites of one property, with their room type. Use pageToken from the previous answer to read the next page. Exely API: GET /api/pms/v2/properties/{propertyId}/rooms.

tools.name: exely_list_bookings
tools.description: List booking summaries of one property, by last modification time. Pass lastModification (UTC) for the first call, or continueToken from the previous answer, not both. Without either, the search starts in 2009 and can return many bookings. Exely API: GET /api/read-reservation/v1/properties/{property

tools.name: exely_get_booking
tools.description: Get the details of one booking: dates, room stays, rates, services, totals, status and guest names. Exely API: GET /api/read-reservation/v1/properties/{propertyId}/bookings/{number}.

tools.name: exely_get_booking_by_external_number
tools.description: Get the details of one booking by its external number from a booking channel (for example an OTA booking id) and the channel code. Exely API: GET /api/read-reservation/v1/properties/{propertyId}/bookings/by-external-number.

tools.name: exely_get_daily_occupancy
tools.description: Get the daily occupancy statistics of one property for a stay period. The period is at most 31 days. Pass otbDate to count only the bookings that existed on that date (on-the-books view). Exely API: GET /api/pms-analytics/v1/properties/{propertyId}/daily-occupancy.
